details.name: ISO 19005-4:2020 - 6.1.9 Inline image dictionaries - Correct Length
details.description: Any inline image dictionary shall contain a L key whose value is the length of the data as it appears in the stream, before applying the filters, if any.

rule.description: Any inline image dictionary shall contain a L key whose value is the length of the data as it appears in the stream, before applying the filters, if any.

error.message: The value of the L key %1 in the inline image dictionary does not represent actual length of the data %2
